text:
Jordan Lee: Hi all 11 excited to join — quick MDM snag. After initial setup Kandji says 'Awaiting e-signature' but I can't find any DocuSign link. Laptop is M1 Air.

Priya Patel: Welcome! HR handles the device agreement. Sending you the DocuSign now. Are you on company wifi or home? If home, VPN flow can be flaky for first handshake.

Jordan Lee: On home Wi-Fi. I tried VPN but it keeps saying 'device not trusted'. No sudo on this account yet.

IT Bot: Ticket #RD-2026-2043 opened and assigned to Priya Patel.

Priya Patel: Resent DocuSign to jordan.lee@redwood.com (48h). I'll also queue a temporary admin grant for 2 hours so you can run any cert install commands.

Jordan Lee: Signed. Kandji now shows 'profile installed failed: missing root cert'. Ran `fdesetup status` 1 says FileVault On.

Priya Patel: Try this manual CA install if you're comfortable:
```
curl -fsS -o /tmp/redwood-root.crt https://pki.redwood.internal/root.crt
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain /tmp/redwood-root.crt
```
If sudo errors, reply and I'll remote in.

Jordan Lee: Got "added certificate" after running those. Kandji now shows 'profile installed' but Zscaler still stuck on device trust.

DevOps Oncall: If Zscaler doesn't finish try restarting the service: `sudo pkill -f Zscaler` then reopen and authenticate. Also check /var/log/zscaler.log for clues.

Jordan Lee: PKILL worked. VPN auth succeeded and Kandji shows enrolled. Thanks!

Priya Patel: Noted temp-admin used and auto-revoked. If you need Rosetta or virtualization permissions, we can do a quick remote session to approve system extensions.

Jordan Lee: Need Rosetta for one legacy tool. Using temp sudo to run `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` now.

Priya Patel: Perfect. FYI we recommend waiting on major OS upgrades until after onboarding; patch-levels are fine. Welcome aboard!

Jordan Lee: All set. Docker starts, codedev container works. Appreciate the quick help :party:
file_creation_notes: MDM enrollment, DocuSign e-sign, CA cert manual install, Zscaler device trust, temp sudo, Rosetta install. Kept conversational Slack style and short messages.
